description: Help hiring managers and interviewers create structured interview plans with competency-based questions and scorecards for evaluating candidates. Use when the user is an employer/recruiter preparing to interview job candidates, not for job seekers preparing for their own interviews. Trigger phrases include "interview plan for [role]", "interview questions for [role]", "how should we interview [role]", "scorecard for [role]", or when discussing structured hiring processes.
